title: Load test: 200 mixed streams on a real cluster
description: Serves "Growing is adding machines."; "Play starts in seconds and keeps up.". A load test of the new playback on a real cluster.
acceptanceCriteria: 200 mixed playbacks of the new API (as they are, converted, re-encoded, and stepping down and up) with a stated rebuffer ratio and p95s for starts, seeks and browsing
A stated target for time to first frame on a start and on a seek, held at 200 streams and recorded run over run, so 'play starts in seconds' is measured
